o: For the Kardashian-Jenners, a new chapter starts now. This season is all about love, reinvention, and what comes next. Kris, Kourtney, Kim, Khloé, Kendall, and Kylie balance empire-building with something far more personal, from unexpected sparks and new relationships, to healing old wounds and embracing independence. As the family steps into this new era, they'll discover that love, whether…

eps.o: The Kardashians are back! Kim, Kris and Khloé head to New York for a major product launch. Back home, Kourtney navigates the fallout from last season and helps Landon Barker achieve an important milestone.

Khloé expands her brand but may have lost her groove when it comes to men. Kourtney helps Landon grow more independent, and Kim balances negative press with bringing a little magic back into Kris’s life.

While Khloé reflects on her patterns in relationships, Kourtney supports her stepkids through big events in their lives. Kim manifests her dream man while starring in a new film, and Kendall reaches a major life goal: buying her dream home.

eps.t: Not a Cheater, Not a Liar
eps.o: Kim, Khloé and Kendall juggle busy work projects alongside a health issue, a trip to Vegas, a new snack line and the potential for romance. In Palm Springs, Kourtney and three generations of the Barker family gather to watch Landon open for Blink 182! Meanwhile, Kris grapples with not getting enough quality time with her kids.
